name: Idempotency
short_description: A property of an operation or deployment that produces the same result no matter how many times it is run; in infrastructure as code, re-running a deployment only changes what differs from the desired state.

evidence.quote: The result is something called idempotency.
you need to understand the idempotent principle before you write a single line
Workflow owners can focus on integration, integrity, idempotency and data contracts.
Logic flows with idempotency, so run it again doesn't duplicate side effects.
Bounded retries, e-dempetency, audit trail, and compensation when something partially succeeds.
